notes.title: Update(Demo) 0.2.0 - New cards, new arena, new game mode and more!
notes.notes:
The world of GELETERRA is full of news!

New legendary spells

 Passion Meteor: For 10 mana, deals 10 damage to target tile plus 5 to adjacent tiles.
 Blizzard: For 0 mana, freezes all enemy slimes.

We felt one legendary spell wasn't enough for all decks, so now "Black Hole" has two powerful competitors!

New common spells

 Bath: For 4 mana, removes all effects from target slime.
 Acid Rain: For 4 mana, poisons all enemy slimes.
 Tremor: For 4 mana, removes construction from target tile.
 Kiss: For 2 mana, applies "Passion" to target slime.
 Protection: For 2 mana, applies "Protection" to target slime.


New addition: Effects
Effects are modifiers that change slimes' behavior. Some were already in-game but weren't officially "Effects".


 Freeze: Frozen slimes can't attack next turn (removes after).
 Passion: When attacking, 2/6 chance to self-damage (removes on trigger).
 Confusion: When attacking, 2/6 chance to miss (removes on trigger).
 Poison: Deals 1 damage at start of placement phase.
 Explosion: Attacks deal half damage (rounded down) to adjacent tiles.
 Protection: Blocks next attack's damage completely.


New slimes

 Necromancer:
  
   HP: 4
   Damage: 1
   Active: For 1 mana, summons Ghost on target tile.
  
 Ghost:
  
   HP: 2
   Damage: 1
   Passive: Always attacks enemy hero during its turn.
  


New buildings

 Steel Forge: For 3 mana, gives +1 armor to slime on tile.
 Gunpowder Canyon: For 5 mana, grants "Explosion" to slime on tile.


New game mode

 Player vs AI: Battle against computer opponents in this new mode.

This 100% single-player experience lets you enjoy Gelecard solo. We'll keep improving the AI in future updates.

Removed cards

 Sprout: While charming, we felt Necromancer better fit "Dark Forest" identity (still appears as Brotinho's evolution).
 Big Factory & Refinery: Removed due to similar effects among Miner buildings.


Card changes

 Cheese Bread: Nerfed to balance Miner deck:
  
   HP: 3→2
   Damage: 2→1
  
 Little Miner: Adjusted for balance:
  
   HP: 5→4
   Damage: 4→3
  
 Ore: New active ability:
  
   For 6 mana, deals 1 damage to all enemy slimes
  
 Little Sprout: Faster evolution but weaker:
  
   HP: 2→1
   Now evolves after 1 turn (was 2)
  
 Sprout: Adjusted for balance:
  
   HP: 4→3
  
 Graveyard: New thematic effect:
  
   When allied slime dies here, summons Ghost
  
 Lake of Regret: More distinct identity:
  
   Enemy slimes attacking here get -1 damage
  
 Cardinal: New support ability:
  
   For 2 mana, heals adjacent allies +2
  
 Believer: Healing cost increased:
  
   Active cost: 1→2
  
 Cathedral: Effect moved to Basilica
 Basilica: Now grants:
  
   +3 max HP to all allies when slime present
  
 Marshmallow: Complete rework:
  
   New active: Resurrect last dead slime (costs its mana)
   HP: 5→12
   Damage: 5→0
  


New arena

 Barbarian Camp: New battle arena showcasing barbarians' homeland.


Visual changes

 New button animations
 Animated text effects for cards
 Board redesign with pastel colors
 Armor display in UI
 Double Attack stacks now visible
 Effects now show below health bar


Summary
This update brings more life and variety to matches, plus new ways to play. Thanks to everyone trying the demo! We're working hard to make Gelecard the best it can be!

How to play demo?
Available for free in Steam - just visit the store page and download!

notes.title: Update(Demo) 0.1.12
notes.notes:
Balance


 Rapadura: Rapadura no longer reflects magic damage.
 Pudding: "Pudding Jr." is no longer always spawned awake. Now, it depends on the current status of the Pudding.
 Ice: Frozen slimes can no longer use active abilities.


Features


 New poison effect: New effect to indicate when a slime is poisoned.
 Localization: New translations added for almost all texts currently included in the game.


Bug Fixes


 Slime spawn circle: The effect appeared incorrectly at certain times.
 Consumable actives: Consumable actives can no longer be used on the user themselves.
 Slimes not spawning when taking damage: The slime spawn animation is no longer interrupted when receiving damage.
 Mana cost for actives: The cost of the active ability is now only deducted from the player when the action is actually performed.
 Candy spawn audio: Removed sound that played incorrectly during the spawning of candy slimes.
  Using actives on the wrong turn: It is no longer possible to use active abilities of opponent slimes or during any turn other than your placement turn.
 Slimepedia: Fixed a bug that occurred when switching sections of the Slimepedia multiple times.
 Arena selection interface: Even though arenas are not yet available for selection, the interface is now set up.
 Bishop: The Bishop's passive no longer stops working after playing multiple matches with the game running.


Summary

Small update aimed at resolving some more urgent issues that were compromising the quality of gameplay. We are working hard to make the game experience even better.

Stay tuned, as we will soon bring more news to the battlefields of Gelecard!

How to play the demo?

If you're interested in taking a peek at what we're planning for Gelecard, you can test the online and local player vs player mode while we're still finishing things up.

To do this, simply go to the game's page and look for the free download option. After that, just head to your library, call your friends, and have fun!
